run_ensure_resources: run ensure_resources to set RLIMIT_MEMLOCK to infinity for the current process
test_ensure_resources: test ensure_resources to verify RLIMIT_MEMLOCK is set to RLIM_INFINITY
review_ensure_resources: review ensure_resources to check if setting MEMLOCK to infinity is safe for your environment
refactor_ensure_resources: refactor ensure_resources to also set other resource limits like RLIMIT_NOFILE
summarize_ensure_resources: summarize ensure_resources which calls resource.setrlimit to unlock memory lock limits
